edge_guide_host_catalog_desc: Instead of making separate manifest.json links for 20+ {mods}, you can point all your {mods} to one https://.../catalog.json link with an 'artifacts' list. Sanctuary OS automatically finds each installed {mod} inside catalog.json!

edge_guide_host_github_desc: 1. Make a free public GitHub repo (like my-sims-mods). 2. Upload your exported manifest.json (or one catalog.json for all your {mods}). 3. Click the file on GitHub and click 'Raw' to copy the raw.githubusercontent.com link. 4. Paste that link into Auto-Update Info Link before packing your release .zip!
edge_guide_lineage_how_desc: Sanctuary OS recognizes {mods} by their unique SHA-256 file fingerprint instead of filenames. Every exported manifest.json keeps track of three things so updates never break:
edge_guide_lineage_layer1_desc: Saves the main .package fingerprint plus every sibling .package and .ts4script module in the current release so multi-file {mods} stay grouped under one parent card.
edge_guide_lineage_layer2_desc: Every time you click Pack Release (.zip) in your Sandbox folder, older release fingerprints automatically move into previous_hashes. When Sanctuary OS checks your online manifest.json, any {Citizen} who still has an older file in previous_hashes gets an Update Available badge!
edge_guide_lineage_layer3_desc: When a {Citizen} drops your new v1.1.0 .zip into Sanctuary OS, it checks their {Vault} against previous_hashes. Even if you renamed MyMod_v1.0.package to MyMod_v1.1.package, Sanctuary OS finds the old v1.0 file by its fingerprint and replaces it right in the same subfolder—no duplicate files!
edge_guide_lineage_rules_desc: In Rules & Upload, required {mods} and conflicts can match other {mods} by file fingerprint, catalog ID, or plain {mod} name (like 'XML Injector').
edge_guide_lineage_rules_title: Easy Required {Mods} & Conflicts (By Fingerprint or Name)
edge_guide_step1_desc: Drop your .package, .ts4script, and optional .cfg/.ini files into Dev/Sandbox (or click Import in the {Mason} Studio). Open the {mod} card and fill in Details & Versions (Name, Version, Content Rating 0–4, Patch Versions), Files & Folders (Twin scripts, Add-ons, Folder Layout), and Rules & Upload (Required Packs, Required {Mods}, and Conflicts).
edge_guide_step2_desc: Paste the link where your manifest.json (for one {mod}) or catalog.json (all your {mods} in one file) will live—like GitHub Raw, Cloudflare Pages, or your own site. Sanctuary OS packs this link right inside manifest.json and override.json in your release .zip!
edge_guide_step3_desc: Click Pack Release (.zip) in Rules & Upload (or the top-right inbox button). Sanctuary OS fingerprints every file in your release, saves manifest.json and override.json in your Sandbox folder, and creates {ModName}_v{Version}_SanctuaryRelease.zip. Upload the .zip to Patreon, Itch.io, CurseForge, or SFS, and upload manifest.json to your link!
edge_guide_step4_desc: When you make v1.1.0+, drop the new .package/.ts4script files into the same Sandbox folder, update the Version number, and click Pack Release (.zip) again. Sanctuary OS automatically remembers your old v1.0.0 file fingerprints inside previous_hashes and saves the new ones as current_hashes. Upload the updated manifest.json to your link—every {Citizen} with v1.0.0 will get an Update Available alert right away!
edge_guide_step5_desc: A {Citizen} drags your .zip into Sanctuary OS once. With zero annoying popups, Sanctuary OS saves your update link, marks the {mod} Up to Date, groups multi-file {mods} into one tidy card, checks Required Packs & Conflicts, alerts them when you update manifest.json, and swaps out old files automatically when they drop the new .zip!

schema_doc_ext_ignore_desc: Harmless readme or notes files (.txt, .md) ignored by the Unidentified File scanner.
schema_doc_cache_files_desc: Game cache files (like localthumbcache.package) that get cleared automatically when you switch {Blueprints}.

lex_doc_meta_desc: Set your word pack's name, language code (en, es, fr, de), creator name, and version number.
lex_doc_batch_desc: Find any word across all 1,700+ lines and replace it in one click! Use the glass switches for Whole Word or Match Case.
